description: Frozen target mapping rules for zero-shot external evaluation of Phase 10R model on CT-ORG

brain.evaluation_criterion: voxel count >= 10 in segmentation and scan covers cranial region

kidney_right.evaluation_criterion: 3D CC analysis in canonical RAS: two largest CC >= 95% total kidney volume; component with larger X coord is patient Right

kidney_left.evaluation_criterion: 3D CC analysis in canonical RAS: two largest CC >= 95% total kidney volume; component with smaller X coord is patient Left

lungs.reason: Whole lung mask cannot be mapped onto individual lung lobes

bone.reason: Whole bone mask cannot be mapped onto individual vertebrae/ribs
